The patch adds 12 tests in ASN1Tests.swift and UTCTimeTests.swift, extends the existing UTF8String test with two non-ASCII checks, and repairs a missing rejection assertion in testSequenceMustConsumeAllNodes with XCTAssertThrowsError: 15 proposed cases in total. Mutant 32 demonstrates that missing assertion; the successful child-decoding assertions remain useful. The duplicate testSequenceConsumption is package evidence only. The last two rows are representation tests. No other missing rejection assertion was identified.

## Notes

The two deferred cases stay in the package and mutation matrix. testDepth50 freezes an internal resource limit without a public guarantee. Mutant 21 fires only on input byte 79 (0x4f), the first OID subidentifier for 1.39. Open PR [#132](https://github.com/apple/swift-asn1/pull/132), dated 2026-09-09, "Decode OID second components above 39 correctly", already adds `(79, [1, 39])`. The cold review supplied with Brief 4 checked that PR diff; this offline run does not fetch it. Credit for that case belongs to #132, and it is omitted from this patch.

The package discriminators are shown below. The reviewed upstream versions have descriptive names, malformed-encoding comments and error-code assertions. The tag-based whole-file copies in upstream/ are disposable formatter inputs and are excluded from the publication set; copying them over main would remove #134 tests. Apply the patch to main to preserve those tests.

```swift
// generated by Codex gpt-6.1-sol on 2026-10-09 for Ivo Matijasevic
import XCTest
@testable import SwiftASN1

final class MissingAcceptanceTests: XCTestCase {
    func testNonminimalLength() throws {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try DER.parse([4, 0x81, 1, 0x41]))
    }

    func testBERPrimitiveIndefinite() throws {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try BER.parse([4, 0x80, 0, 0]))
    }

    func testDepth50() throws {
        var bytes: [UInt8] = [5, 0]
        for _ in 0..<49 { bytes = [0x30, UInt8(bytes.count)] + bytes }
        XCTAssertNoThrow(try DER.parse(bytes))
    }

    func testNonemptyNull() throws {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ASN1Null(derEncoded: [5, 1, 0]))
    }

    func testDERBoolean01() throws {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try Bool(derEncoded: [1, 1, 1]))
    }

    func testBooleanFalse() throws {
        XCTAssertFalse(try Bool(derEncoded: [1, 1, 0]))
    }

    func testBooleanSerialize() throws {
        var serializer = DER.Serializer()
        try serializer.serialize(true)
        XCTAssertEqual(serializer.serializedBytes, [1, 1, 0xff])
    }

    func testUnsignedNegative() throws {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try UInt(derEncoded: [2, 1, 0xff]))
    }

    func testBitPaddingEight() throws {
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try ASN1BitString(derEncoded: [3, 2, 8, 0]))
    }

    func testOIDFirstPairBoundary() throws {
        XCTAssertEqual(try ASN1ObjectIdentifier(derEncoded: [6, 1, 79]).oidComponents, [1, 39])
    }

    func testUTF8NonASCII() throws {
        let string: String = "é"
        XCTAssertEqual(ASN1UTF8String(string).bytes, [0xc3, 0xa9])
    }

    func testSequenceConsumption() throws {
        let node = try DER.parse([0x30, 2, 5, 0])
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try DER.sequence(node, identifier: .sequence) { _ in 0 })
    }

    func testEncodedDefault() throws {
        let node = try DER.parse([0x30, 3, 2, 1, 1])
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try DER.sequence(node, identifier: .sequence) { nodes in
            try DER.decodeDefault(&nodes, identifier: .integer, defaultValue: 1) { try Int(derEncoded: $0) }
        })
    }

    func testUTC1950() throws {
        XCTAssertNoThrow(try UTCTime(year: 1950, month: 1, day: 1, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0))
    }

    func testBEREmptyOctets() throws {
        XCTAssertEqual(try ASN1OctetString(berEncoded: [0x24, 0]).bytes, [])
    }

    func testUTF8ToString() throws {
        XCTAssertEqual(String(ASN1UTF8String("é")), "é")
    }

    func testIntegerIndexGreater() throws {
        let bytes = IntegerBytesCollection(UInt16(256))
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(bytes.endIndex, bytes.startIndex)
    }

}
```
